description: Fetch the generated creative markup for an ad-tag scan as text — the HTML the ad tag produced, with the scripts, iframes and click-through URLs it embedded. Use it to explain WHY a creative was tagged when a screenshot cannot show it (obfuscated redirectors, hidden trackers, injected handlers). Only ad-tag scans have this artifact; a URL or VAST scan returns not-found. The markup is returned inert as text and is never executed. Markup over 256 KiB is refused — open the report URL from `get_scan` for those.
name: get_scan_creative_html
title: Get Scan Creative HTML
